title: Change pages live on an orphan store branch
context: Split out of ADR-0045. Committing Change pages on the Change branch filled every pull request with diff nobody reviewed, yet every Change must stay browsable after merge.
decision: Change pages are written under gitignored blueprint/content/changes/<slug>/ on the Change branch and never committed there. At each gate `pnpm blueprint:changes:publish <slug>` commits them to the orphan blueprint-changes branch and pushes it; that branch never merges anywhere. `pnpm --filter blueprint dev` and `build` first run `pnpm blueprint:changes:pull`, so every deploy carries every published Change. Features and the Design System stay in git on normal branches, because agents read them as current knowledge and they change with the code.

alternatives.option: Move Blueprint change pages to a separate repository
alternatives.reason: Agents would work across two checkouts per Change, and the build would need a cross-repository fetch.

alternatives.option: Keep Change pages gitignored and local only
alternatives.reason: Every Change must stay browsable on the deployed Blueprint from any device without checking out an old commit.

alternatives.option: Deploy each Change's pages to a preview URL
alternatives.reason: Both gates happen on the developer's machine, so a deploy adds credentials and a step without serving a reader; a preview script can be added when a remote reader appears.

consequences: Pull requests carry code, tests, Feature knowledge, the Changeset and a Review summary; Change pages are not in the diff.
A design mockup outlives its Change only by promotion to the Design System or a Feature, when it becomes a lasting rule.
revisitTriggers: The store branch warns that it has outgrown the threshold ADR-0081 sets.
A gate is reviewed by someone who cannot run the Blueprint locally.
